comment: Operator registry for S3-compatible object stores. Stored at the repo root outside the statically served world/ tree. Credentials come from the standard AWS environment or profile, never from this file. Keys are relative to the configured prefix. allow_write is false by default. get_file and put_file are restricted to agents/<id>/downloads/ and uploads/.

s3_objects.name: S3-compatible objects
s3_objects.description: Example read-only S3-compatible store. Enable after setting the bucket, region, and AWS credentials.
